name: Light Propagation Volume (LPV) / Opacity Propagation Volume (OPV)
definition: A GPU-based technique to compute the optical depth T(X,S) between each light source S and each grid cell X by propagating density information radially from the light source through a 3D volume, using a modified version of Crytek's algorithm.
summary: Light Propagation Volume is a real-time GPU method that precomputes optical depth by propagating density radially from light sources through a 3D grid to enable accurate shadowing in participating media.
